name: SN 1983E field (Hubble)
blurb: The site of the supernova SN 1983E, seen by Hubble.
label: sn1983efield-hubble
story: Hubble returned to the place where a hydrogen-rich Type II supernova exploded, studying the stars around it to estimate the mass of the star that blew up and to look for any lingering glow.

claims.text: SN 1983E is a Type II supernova targeted by program 17070, Snapshot Observations of Type II Supernovae
The program resolves stellar populations around Type II supernovae to estimate progenitor masses and searches for late-time emission
